scope: 108 full-slot standard/damage/defence builds, levels 1/8/15/25/35/45, male body, 60/25/15 allocation, untrained spells. Coordinate ascent is an outlier search, not an exhaustive optimum. Common items, shields, two rings, two armlets and two bracers are included. Weight must fit. Sustained 60s uses full starting TP, standing recovery and pet call/upkeep; offensive casting and healing budgets are alternatives, not simultaneous. Damage/area calculations use reference armour/evasion; defence uses a level-appropriate installed encounter at one incoming attack per second. Movement, range, misses in player targeting and time reaching enemies are not simulated.
